text:
Headache clinic

34M, chronic migraine without aura, 18 headache days a month on a diary, 8 of them disabling.

Failed propranolol (bradycardia), amitriptyline (sedation) and topiramate (word finding
difficulty). Now on candesartan 8 mg with partial benefit.

Medication overuse is likely: he is taking sumatriptan 12 to 15 days a month. Withdrawal
discussed at length and he has agreed to try.

No papilloedema, no focal deficit, no thunderclap onset and no new headache in the last year
that is different in character. Imaging is not indicated and I have explained why.

If the diary shows 15 or more headache days a month after triptan withdrawal he becomes eligible
for a CGRP monoclonal, and I would refer at that point.

Grandmother and mother both had migraine.

Follow up after neurology.

Triptan use down to 6 days a month. Diary shows 12 headache days last month, improving.

Tired all the time. Hb 11.8 g/dL, MCV 78, ferritin 11 ng/mL. Iron deficiency anaemia, source
unclear.

Coeliac serology sent. FIT sent. Not anaemic previously - the 2021 bloods were normal.

He is not vegetarian and there is no overt bleeding.

Ferrous sulfate 200 mg od started. Recheck in 8 weeks. Will refer to gastroenterology if the FIT
is positive or the ferritin does not respond.
